title.en: An Act Amending Subparagraph (c) of the First Paragraph of Section One Hundred Eighty Eight of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred Sixty Six as Amended

text.en:
Subparagraph (c) of the first paragraph of Section one hundred eighty-eight of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four hundred sixty-six, as amended is hereby further amended as follows:
"Sec. 188. Transactions and persons not subject to percentage tax. — In computing the tax imposed in Sections One hundred eighty-four, One hundred eighty-five, and Hundred eighty-six transactions in the following commodities shall be excluded:
"(a) … "(b) … "(c) Minerals and mineral products, whether in their original state or not when sold, bartered, or exchanged by the lessee, concessionaire or owner of the mineral land from which removed. x x x x x x x x x

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
